spans.s:
स्त्यान, अस्, आ, अम्, collecting into a mass; thick,
bulky, gross; soft, bland, unctuous, smooth; sound-
ing; (अम्), n. thickness, grossness, massiveness;
unctuousness; nectar; idleness, sloth; echo, sound.

स्त्यै स्त्यै (also written ष्ट्यै), cl. 1. P.
स्त्यायति, &c., to be collected into a heap
or mass; to be spread about; to sound; [cf. accord-
ing to some, probably Gr. στενός; Lat. stipare.]

स्त्यायन, अम्, n. collecting into a mass, aggrega-
tion, crowding together.

. fr.
rt. स्त्यै above), nectar (= अ-मृत); a thief (in
this sense probably for स्तेन, q. v.).
